members.name: RUNIT_DATA_PROVIDER_BLE
members.description: The endpoint is a characteristic UUID.

members.name: SYS_BLE_EVENT_CONNECT
members.description: The app connected (value = connection handle)

members.name: SYS_BLE_EVENT_DISCONNECT
members.description: The app disconnected (value = reason code)

members.name: SYS_BLE_EVENT_FAILURE
members.description: A connection, receive or send failure (value = error code)

members.name: SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_LOGS
members.description: Text log lines.

members.name: SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_ERRORS
members.description: Binary error reports.

members.name: SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_TELEMETRY
members.description: Program object values you subscribed to.

members.name: SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_INTERFACE
members.description: Commands to the board and their responses.

members.name: SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_APP_BASE
members.description: Connectors you create use this ID or higher.

members.name: SYS_DEVICE_CONTRACT_IO
members.description: Basic pin control - read or drive a pin, or measure/generate a voltage on it

members.name: SYS_DEVICE_CONTRACT_POWER_VREG
members.description: An adjustable power output - turn it on/off and set its voltage and current limit

members.name: SYS_DEVICE_CONTRACT_POWER_MONITOR
members.description: Measures voltage and current on a power rail, with optional over-current alerts

members.name: SYS_DEVICE_CONTRACT_POWER_USB_PD
members.description: Negotiates power (voltage/current) from a USB-C charger

members.name: SYS_DEVICE_CONTRACT_HBRIDGE
members.description: Drives a DC motor forward, backward, or brakes it

members.name: SYS_DEVICE_CONTRACT_MAX
members.description: Not a real contract - marks the end of the list, used internally for bounds checking

members.name: SYS_DEV_IMPORTANCE_NONE
members.description: Disables automatic handling for this device.

members.name: SYS_DEV_IMPORTANCE_LOW
members.description: Handles only low-severity device errors.

members.name: SYS_DEV_IMPORTANCE_MEDIUM
members.description: Handles low and medium-severity device errors.

members.name: SYS_DEV_IMPORTANCE_HIGH
members.description: Handles low through high-severity device errors.

members.name: SYS_DEV_IMPORTANCE_CRITICAL
members.description: Handles every device error severity.

members.name: SYS_EVENT_DOMAIN_IO
members.description: Pin interrupts and analog alerts. Channel = pin, event = the edge or window crossed, value = level or mV

members.name: SYS_EVENT_DOMAIN_POWER
members.description: Regulator, monitor and board power events. Event = power event; board events use device 255

members.name: SYS_EVENT_DOMAIN_HBRIDGE
members.description: Motor driver faults. Channel = bridge channel, event = fault reason, value = current in mA

members.name: SYS_EVENT_DOMAIN_BLE
members.description: Connection events. Event = BLE event

members.name: SYS_EVENT_DOMAIN_FEATURE
members.description: Events raised by features. Device = feature ID

members.name: SYS_HBRIDGE_MODE_FULL
members.description: Bidirectional drive from -1.0 to 1.0

members.name: SYS_HBRIDGE_MODE_HALF_HIGH
members.description: High-side PWM drive from 0.0 to 1.0

members.name: SYS_HBRIDGE_MODE_HALF_LOW
members.description: Low-side PWM sink from 0.0 to 1.0

members.name: SYS_HBRIDGE_FAULT_NONE
members.description: No fault

members.name: SYS_HBRIDGE_FAULT_OVERCURRENT
members.description: The channel drew more than its current limit

members.name: SYS_HBRIDGE_FAULT_THERMAL_OR_UVLO
members.description: The driver chip overheated or its supply dropped too low; every channel stops

members.name: SYS_HBRIDGE_FAULT_EXTERNAL
members.description: An external fault input was triggered

members.name: SYS_INTERFACE_STATUS_OK
members.description: The command succeeded. Any response data follows.

members.name: SYS_INTERFACE_STATUS_ERROR
members.description: The command failed. The root cause's error tag and owner follow; the full error chain is sent on the errors stream.

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_INPUT
members.description: Reads whether the pin is on or off - use for buttons, switches, and sensors that output a simple on/off signal

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_INPUT_PULLUP
members.description: Same as Input, but reads "on" by default when nothing is connected - use when your button/switch connects the pin to ground when pressed

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_INPUT_PULLDOWN
members.description: Same as Input, but reads "off" by default when nothing is connected - use when your button/switch connects the pin to power when pressed

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_OUTPUT_PUSH_PULL
members.description: Standard output - the pin can actively switch between on and off. Use this for most outputs like LEDs and relays

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_OUTPUT_OPEN_DRAIN
members.description: A weaker output that can only actively pull the signal to "off" - something else (an external resistor, or the Open-Drain-Pullup option) is needed to make it read "on". Mainly used when several devices need to share the same wire

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_OUTPUT_OPEN_DRAIN_PULLUP
members.description: Same as Open-Drain, but with a built-in helper enabled so the pin reads "on" by itself instead of needing an extra part

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_PWM
members.description: Rapidly switches the pin on and off to fake an in-between level - use to dim an LED or control a motor's speed

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_ADC
members.description: Measures the exact voltage on the pin instead of just on/off - use to read sensors that report a varying value, like a potentiometer or a temperature sensor

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_DAC
members.description: Outputs an exact, steady voltage level instead of just on/off - the opposite of ADC

members.name: SYS_IO_INTR_DISABLE
members.description: Don't watch this pin for changes - nothing gets triggered

members.name: SYS_IO_INTR_MODE_RISING_EDGE
members.description: Triggers the instant the pin switches from off to on

members.name: SYS_IO_INTR_MODE_FALLING_EDGE
members.description: Triggers the instant the pin switches from on to off

members.name: SYS_IO_INTR_MODE_BOTH_EDGES
members.description: Triggers on any change - whether the pin switches from off to on, or on to off

members.name: SYS_IO_INTR_ADC_WINDOW_OUTSIDE
members.description: Triggers when the measured value leaves the safe/expected range you set - use to catch a value going too high or too low

members.name: SYS_IO_INTR_ADC_WINDOW_INSIDE
members.description: Triggers when the measured value comes back into the range you set - use to catch when a value returns to normal

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_NONE
members.description: Nothing wrong - normal operation

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_OVP
members.description: The voltage went above the safe limit

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_UVP
members.description: The voltage dropped below the safe limit

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_SPC
members.description: A short circuit was detected on the output

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_OCP_WARNING
members.description: Current draw is approaching the limit - not cut off yet, just a heads-up

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_OCP_CRITICAL
members.description: Current draw exceeded the limit - output is protected/shut down

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_OTP
members.description: The device got too hot and triggered thermal protection

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_BATTERY_LOW
members.description: The battery charge fell to the low threshold

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_BATTERY_CRITICAL
members.description: The battery charge fell to the critical threshold

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
members.description: The power source can no longer cover what the outputs are set to draw

members.name: SYS_PWR_EVENT_SOURCE_CHANGED
members.description: The board switched to another power source (the value is the new source)

members.name: SYS_POWER_USB_PD_OPTION_FIXED
members.description: A fixed voltage.

members.name: SYS_POWER_USB_PD_OPTION_PPS
members.description: Programmable voltage within a range (standard power range, up to 21 V).

members.name: SYS_POWER_USB_PD_OPTION_AVS
members.description: Adjustable voltage within a range (extended power range, up to 28 V).

members.name: SYS_POWER_SOURCE_UNKNOWN
members.description: Not identified; the budget uses the measured input voltage and the board's assumed current

members.name: SYS_POWER_SOURCE_USB_PD
members.description: USB-C Power Delivery; the budget uses the input voltage and the source's current

members.name: SYS_POWER_SOURCE_PSU
members.description: External supply; the budget uses the input voltage and the current entered by the user

members.name: SYS_POWER_SOURCE_BATTERY
members.description: Battery; the budget uses the measured voltage, current limited only by the board

members.name: SYS_POWER_RESPONSE_NOTIFY
members.description: Only raise the event

members.name: SYS_POWER_RESPONSE_DISABLE
members.description: Suspend the affected output: that rail, or every rail for a board-level event

members.name: SYS_POWER_RESPONSE_RESET
members.description: Reset the affected device: that rail, or every rail for a board-level event

members.name: SYS_POWER_RESPONSE_SAFE_STATE
members.description: Stop the program and suspend every device

members.name: SYS_POWER_BATTERY_NONE
members.description: No battery configured

members.name: SYS_POWER_BATTERY_LIPO
members.description: Lithium polymer, 4.2 V per cell when full

members.name: VM_ACTION_SCOPE_STATIC
members.description: A built-in action (freeze, safe state, device reset, ...)

members.name: VM_ACTION_SCOPE_RECORDED
members.description: A recorded packet sequence

members.name: VM_OBJ_NONE
members.description: No payload type.

members.name: VM_OBJ_PTR
members.description: A reference to another VM object.

members.name: VM_IDX_LITERAL
members.description: A fixed array position.

members.name: VM_IDX_REF
members.description: Read another accessor to obtain the index.

members.name: VM_IDX_NAME
members.description: Find a child object by its tag.
